verdict.rationale: Obsidian stores notes as Markdown plain text, which implies headings, tables and code blocks. It ships its own editing surfaces: a mobile editing toolbar, a Command Palette, and a Vim mode that a community report references while describing a cursor bug. That supports a keyboard-driven Markdown editor, but the pack never documents the specific formatting elements the story lists. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of callouts, tables, code blocks and embedded media/transclusion; evidence of editor speed; independent hands-on corroboration of the formatting workflow.
